description: This file defines the QueryThingsResponse class, which represents the response to a 'QueryThings' command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the search result, and setting headers. It is part of the 'thingsearch.query' package and is associated with handling JSON serialization/deserialization and HTTP response details for the command.

classes.name: QueryThingsResponse
classes.description: Final class representing the response to a 'QueryThings' command, encapsulating search result data and JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new QueryThingsResponse instance with the provided search result and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a QueryThingsResponse from a JSON string or JSON object with specified headers.

methods.name: getSearchResult
methods.description: Returns the SearchResult object contained in the response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the search result to a JSON value based on schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity of the response from a JSON value, returning a new instance.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder, respecting schema and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the provided headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code considering superclass and search result.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class, superclass, and search result.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals, confirms other object is of compatible type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response including search result.
